title: Make offline migration preflight sidecars before moves and recover failed activation safely
outcome: Make offline migration preflight sidecars before moves and recover failed activation safely
acceptance: A converted SQLite database with WAL/SHM produced by read-only comparison is safely checkpointed or refused before any live file moves; a regression reproduces this failure.
A disposable cutover exercises success and preflight failure, preserving originals and leaving live paths unchanged on preflight refusal.
Recover the failed Phoenix activation without overwriting either the original pre-cutover data or the newly created post-restart database; inspect recovery receipts before retrying installation.

completion.summary: Fixed converted-sidecar preflight ordering and SQLite finalization; disposable failure/success and recovery replay tests passed. Operator recovered Phoenix without losing either dataset and installed both converted stores; parent post-install readback passed. Independent Claude7170 accepted all3 unchanged criteria (asserted), not host-attested execution.
